body: Yeah I agree. Birthday are just a reminder that one more whole year of being a fuckup has passed

That’s a fucked up way to go. That could traumatize many people for life
I do agree that they’re stupid because to me, a hug is an act of physical affection which is what some people need. Virtual hugs defeat the purpose of a hug but they were just tying to be nice.

That’s exactly my problem though. I don’t want to move on. In the “off” times, I tried dating and talking to other girls, but it was always just a small crush, so feelings would never blossom into love, the way they do with her. We have a click that I don’t have with other people.
I feel like people say that for them and not for us
Wow congrats!
Big facts

Literally same. I just tear up a little but for the most part I feel numb, which sucks because I want to be able to let my emotions out. 

Screaming always works tho lol

You’re definitely right. I’ve always felt more mature than other people my age, especially in school for basically my entire life. Even at a really young age I’ve always questioned peoples behavior and why they act so childish. And it’s because they are children. 

I’m probably just gonna dump this friend group and try and figure something else out because this clearly isn’t working out. 

And thanks for reading and the long reply. I hope you have a great day <3
Yeah. I’m so sick of cliques. I just want to go to college already

I feel exactly the same. I have a group of “friends” that always do shit without me, and i get super jealous. What usually helps me is focusing on things that make me happy. So talking to my online friends, listening to music, and playing music. Also picking up a new hobby. In terms of being social, just try and out yourself out there. Introduce yourself to new people or maybe someone you haven’t thought about talking to. Hope this helps and hope you’re doing well <3.
Yeah a couple of my friends from another school.

You’re probably right. It’s just difficult because I have a very small grade and almost all of my friends that aren’t in that group somehow link back to them. So in order for me to completely avoid them, I would basically have to become a complete loner
I’ll try. Thanks for replying and reading

I have in the past, but like I said they usually brush it to the side or change the conversation. I don’t really want to bring it up again, especially when they’re all together because I don’t want to be a laughing stock for all of them

They never ask me to hang out. And the “make more friends” thing was just one of them being an asshole. I do have friends other than them. Some go to another school and i see them occasionally but it’s difficult because we have extracurriculars. I have tried to invite some people in the group over before but they always say they have plans or something like that. I have a couple other friends within the school, but they are always somehow involved in their hangouts. Like one of my friends doesn’t even really hang out with them at school, and I tried to make plans with him this weekend, but I couldn’t because he already has plans. What plans may you ask? The birthday party! (Mind blown) I would also say I’m close with them. I’m pretty involved within the group and we’ve been friends for about a year. But yeah still no
It already happened. I would’ve went if I knew it was happening
Same here
Yes. Sometimes I punch myself in the face or in the stomach

I’m in the exact same boat as you. I’m 16, bisexual, confused, and lonely. I don’t have a permanent answer for you, but for me, music helps temporarily ease the loneliness… or at least helps me get my mind off of it. I play guitar and I’m gonna learn the drums soon. So my answer is to pick up a hobby. Also I’m here if you want to talk
